annotations.title: Find a ticker by company name

description: Look up the ticker for a company name or partial symbol — 'Apple', 'TSMC', '2330', 'samsung', 'LVMH'. Returns up to 8 matches, each with its ticker, name and market; a local subsidiary or a namesake in another country can share a name, and the market tells them apart. market (US, JP, TW, KR, FR, BE, DK, EE, SE, SK, LV, AU, NZC) limits the search to one market. Results with market NZC are New Zealand registered charities, not companies.

market.description: Only this market: US, JP, TW, KR, FR, BE, DK, EE, SE, SK, LV, AU, NZC
